item.title: SUNshine Girl Jessica
item.description: SUNshine Girl Jessica is an actor who has been in short films and movies. Back when she posed for these photos in March 2019, she had 10 credits on IMDb. The 5-foot-4 brunette has studied at a private career college to become a professional esthetician. (Jack Boland/Toronto Sun)
